 /api/rp/results/search.{format}:
  get:
   tags:
    - Repo and Reverse Repo Operations
   summary: Filter operations
   description: Returns Repo and/or Reverse Repo operation Results.
   produces:
    - application/json
    - text/xml
    - text/csv
    - application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet
   parameters:
    - in: path
      name: format
      required: true
      description: The format of the response.
      schema:
       type: string
       enum: [json,xml,csv,xlsx]                        
    - in: query
      name: startDate
      required: false
      description: The start date (inclusive) from which to search. <br/> <i>Format yyyy-MM-dd</i> 
      schema:
       type: string
       format: date
    - in: query
      name: endDate
      required: false
      description: The end date (inclusive) up until which to search. <br/> <i>Format yyyy-MM-dd</i>  
      schema:
       type: string
       format: date           
    - in: query
      name: operationTypes
      required: false
      description: The operation types (comma-delimited) by which to filter.
      schema:
       type: string
       enum: [Repo,Reverse Repo]      
    - in: query
      name: method
      required: false
      description: The operation method by which to filter.
      schema:
       type: string
       enum: [multiple,single,fixed,allotment]
    - in: query
      name: securityType
      required: false
      description: The security type (tranche) by which to filter. For specific types, only operations which include that type will be returned.
      schema:
       type: string
       enum: [mbs,agency,tsy,srf]       
    - in: query
      name: term
      required: false
      description: The term of the operation.
      schema:
       type: string
       enum: [overnight,term]                  
   responses:
    '200':
     $ref: '#/components/responses/repo-response'
    '400':
     $ref: '#/components/responses/bad-request-params'
    '5XX':
     $ref: '#/components/responses/unexpected-error'
